checks.name: review_scope
checks.evidence: Independent inspection of directions.png, contact-sheet.png, and qa/final-previews/four-stills.png only. This is a still-image review; animation playback was not inspected.

checks.name: pixel_art_anatomy
checks.evidence: Clock face, eyes, two gloves, arms, legs, and shoes remain readable and connected through the supplied frames. No visibly broken limb was found.

checks.name: silhouette_glow
checks.evidence: The dark-background four-still preview shows a narrow warm halo following the character outline, without a visible rectangular illuminated field.

checks.name: visibility
checks.evidence: The intentionally subdued character remains discernible on the dark background and checkerboard. This visual review does not measure the numeric 40 percent opacity target.

checks.name: scale_consistency
checks.evidence: Head and body proportions stay visually consistent across the contact sheet. Pose changes do not produce a conspicuous scale jump in the still frames.

checks.name: baseline
checks.evidence: Grounded idle, waving, waiting, work/running, and review poses share a stable apparent floor. Raised feet in locomotion are consistent with alternating strides.

checks.name: jump
checks.evidence: Jump frames 1 through 3 lift both shoes above the idle floor; the apex raises the face and hands, followed by a grounded return frame. The separate jump still also has a clear airborne silhouette.

checks.name: work_running_feet
checks.evidence: The stationary row 7 running/work sequence keeps shoes visibly on the floor while arms work at the chest. Locomotion rows alternate supporting and raised legs with no obvious below-floor drift.

checks.name: cardinals
checks.evidence: 000, 090, 180, and 270 read respectively as up, screen-right, down, and screen-left without cardinal ambiguity.

checks.name: all_16_directions
checks.evidence: The gaze proceeds through the expected quadrants around the full loop without an observed wrong quadrant. Near-horizontal intermediate angles 067.5, 112.5, 247.5, and 292.5 have weak vertical separation from nearby views.

checks.name: whole_object_rotation
checks.evidence: Directional look frames retain the same upright clock ticks, shoes, and overall silhouette; gaze direction changes through the eyes.

checks.name: clipping
checks.evidence: No active native frame in the contact sheet visibly cuts off gloves, shoes, glow, or the clock rim. The zoom rows in directions.png are deliberately cropped QA face views.

checks.name: motion_playback
checks.evidence: Not run. Still frames establish poses and jump displacement, but do not establish timing, smoothness, transition quality, or temporal scale stability.

warnings: Near-horizontal intermediate gaze angles have subtle vertical separation; this is acceptable as an intermediate-angle warning because the cardinal directions and quadrant sequence remain coherent.
Animation playback was not reviewed; motion timing and transition smoothness remain unverified.
Exact alpha or 60 percent transparency was not measured in this visual-only review.
